acquisition_method.evidence: inferred: For the publication, LC-MS/MS data were searched with MaxQuant 1.2.2.5 (pY) against all protein sequences annotated in the Human UniProt database (downloaded 2015_12, 20198 entries) and MaxQuant 1.5.2.8 (pSTY) with the human UniProt database (downloaded 2018_5, 20350 entries)25 using the embedded search engine Andromeda.

cleavage_agent.evidence: inferred: Carbamidomethylated cysteines was set as fixed modification and oxidation of methionine, N-terminal protein acetylation and phosphorylation of serine, threonine and trypsin as variable modifications.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphotyrosine peptides were enriched using the PTMScan Phospho-Tyrosine Rabbit mAb (P-Tyr-1000, Cell Signaling #8803) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
pSTY peptides were enriched using an IMAC kit (Sigma I1408) adapted from the manufacturer’s instructions (Sigma-Aldrich) as described below.

fractionation_method.evidence: The basic pH reversed phase liquid chromatography separation (bRPLC) was performed on a XBridge column (4.6 mm ID x 100 mm length) packed with BEH C18 resin (3.5 µm particle size, 130 Å pore size) (Waters).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides were analyzed by LC-MS/MS as described in the chemical proteomics entry.

labeling.evidence: For quantification of the label free pY dataset, peak apexes from extracted ion chromatograms were used; for the TMT 6-plex global pSTY data, the reporter ion intensity was used for relative quantification of each peptide.

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylated cysteines was set as fixed modification and oxidation of methionine, N-terminal protein acetylation and phosphorylation of serine, threonine and trypsin as variable modifications.
